run.change_description: fix(utils/body,validator): normalize Content-Type media type for case-insensitive matching

summary.intent: Fix honojs/hono#5060: `parseBody()` and `validator('json'|'form')` rejected requests whose `Content-Type` media type used mixed or upper case (e.g. `Application/JSON`), even though the platform `Request` parses them fine, so handlers received `{}` or unvalidated data.
summary.issue_fit: Met — `src/utils/body.ts` now compares a lower-cased, `;`-stripped media type before dispatching to form parsing; `src/validator/validator.ts`'s three content-type regexes gained the `i` flag; and `src/utils/buffer.ts`'s `bufferToFormData` now lower-cases only the media-type segment of the header it hands to the platform `Response`, leaving parameters such as multipart boundaries untouched. All three of the issue's suggested tests were added and pass at the reviewed head.
summary.coverage: All 6 changed files read in full against the merge-base diff (6/6 chunks); `src/request.ts`, `src/middleware/method-override/index.ts`, and `src/middleware/body-limit/index.ts` (the other in-repo consumers of `parseBody`/`bufferToFormData`) read to check for regressions in how `HonoRequest`'s body cache and cross-format reuse interact with the new arrayBuffer-based `parseFormData`. Focused vitest run at the reviewed head covers every changed test file.
check_details: Reviewer ran `./node_modules/.bin/vitest --run --project main --coverage.enabled=false src/utils/body.test.ts src/utils/buffer.test.ts src/validator/validator.test.ts` at `5226d4165d48643586152614cbd07422a0ab7a22`: 106 passed, 1 pre-existing unrelated skip, 0 failed.

Codecov's supplied patch-coverage check failed for this PR (76.47% versus an 80% target); not independently reproduced since coverage instrumentation is disabled under this run's execution allowance, and manual trace of the 4 reported-missing lines found no hidden behavioral gap.

observations.fact: The same case-sensitive `Content-Type` gate the issue reported for `parseBody()` still exists in a sibling middleware, untouched by this diff.
observations.evidence: `src/middleware/method-override/index.ts:92` (`contentType?.startsWith('application/x-www-form-urlencoded')`) is unchanged at both merge-base and head, so a mixed-case override form is still silently skipped there; out of this change's scope since it doesn't touch that file.

observations.fact: Codecov reports this diff's patch coverage below the repository's target.
observations.evidence: PR comment: 76.47% patch coverage against an 80% target, 3 missing lines in `src/utils/body.ts` and 1 in `src/utils/buffer.ts`; coverage instrumentation is disabled under this run's execution allowance (`--coverage.enabled=false`), so the exact lines were not independently confirmed.

observations.fact: `parseFormData` in `src/utils/body.ts` now always reads the full request body into an `ArrayBuffer` before parsing form data, where it previously delegated straight to the platform's own `Request.formData()`.
observations.evidence: `src/utils/body.ts:126-132`; this mirrors the buffering `src/validator/validator.ts`'s `form` branch already performed before this diff, and the PR's own HTTP benchmark comment shows body-request throughput essentially unchanged (35,864.38 to 35,802.34, -0.17%).

requirements.source: spec-pr5067-packet/issue-5060 "Supported media type matching should be case-insensitive for the media type portion."
requirements.evidence: src/utils/body.ts:104-106 gates on a lower-cased, semicolon-stripped media type; src/validator/validator.ts:24-26 add the `i` flag to all three content-type regexes; confirmed by the new mixed-case tests passing at 5226d4165d48643586152614cbd07422a0ab7a22.

requirements.source: spec-pr5067-packet/issue-5060 "Parameter values such as multipart boundaries should remain intact."

Diff adds 7 tests across body.test.ts, buffer.test.ts and validator.test.ts (+90 lines) covering mixed-case JSON, urlencoded and multipart content types.
